claims.head: Vasilevskiy doesn’t own the Flyers
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Vasilevskiy has been a wall against the Flyers, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Flyers finally get to him.
claims.nums: 7 starts against Philadelphia: .944 save percentage · .910 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Vasilevskiy’s record against the Flyers.
claims.call: If Vasilevskiy starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .910 than to his .944 against the Flyers.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 7 against Philadelphia, 4,546 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Vasilevskiy: .944 save percentage in 7 starts against Philadelphia since 2023-24.
Vasilevskiy: .910 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 4,546 shots.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 3 games cover only 23% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 62%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen last game. Gage Goncalves takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L4. Emil Lilleberg is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside D'Astous and Hedman.
